- **Local storage** - battery banks at charging sites that charge slowly and discharge quickly, smoothing the demand spike
- **Staged infrastructure investment** - upgrading distribution capacity ahead of projected demand rather than reactively

The planning is genuinely uneven across regions. Some utilities are ahead of it, others are behind. I don't want to give you a rosier picture than reality warrants.
